releaseNotes: v1.1.5: Navigation fix. Edit, Cancel and Save on the Add and Edit pages now move between pages the normal way instead of drawing one page inside another, so going in and out of Add or Edit no longer leaves the app's pages out of order or stuck on an edit. Add and Edit pages also list anything still needed before Save. Same fix as Reolink 1.6.16, thanks to gopher.ny. No Done needed. v1.1.4: Quieter after a hub reboot. The hub's MQTT broker often starts a little after the integration, which logged a warning to run Force Reconnect even though the Bridge connects on its own. Now, for the first 5 minutes after startup it waits quietly, warns only if it still can't connect after that, and skips refreshes asked for while it's connecting, since every remote refreshes once connected. No Done needed.
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Sofabaton Integration
apps.description: Manages one or more Sofabaton X1S or X2 hubs: activities as switches, X2 remote buttons with Button Actions, and setup guides and troubleshooting in one place.

drivers.name: Sofabaton Integration Bridge
drivers.description: Created automatically by the app. Holds the shared MQTT connection for X2 hubs and groups each hub's devices together.

drivers.name: Sofabaton Remote
drivers.description: One per Sofabaton hub, created by the app. Tracks activity changes and fires button events (X2 Hubitat Control commands, X1S IP control). X1S receive path forked from dJOS's Sofabaton X Series driver, see the driver header for credits.

drivers.name: Sofabaton Activity
drivers.description: One per Sofabaton activity, as a switch, created by the app. Starts and stops the activity locally over MQTT (X2) or through Sofabaton's cloud webhook (X1S).
